seo.description_paragraph: Cloris is a Greek goddess name with roots in mythology and religion. Derived from the Greek name Κλωρις (Kloris), meaning 'light, glory', Cloris was revered as a goddess of the moon, spring, and flowers in ancient Greek culture. With the spread of Christianity, Cloris became an adopted name, bringing with it a rich cultural and religious heritage. Today, Cloris is a popular name for girls, appealing to those who value history, spirituality, and a connection to the natural world.
